title: Sung vocal arrangements in the 1934 band
summary: The 1934 band sang I'm Just an Ordinary Human and the background to Kings Don't Mean a Thing in deep harmony like a glee club.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: Yes. We had an arrangement on -- 'I'm Just An Ordinary Human.' Did you ever hear that piece?
(Singing), 'I'm Just An Ordinary Human.' That was both playing and singing. It was a glee club, like.
And then we had -- Kings Don't Mean A Thing On The Street Of Dreams.
And Louis -- we sang -- the didn't play the background for him then. We sang the background. But it was all in harmony, and deep harmony. Not barbershop harmony.
